name: armor
caption: Figure 1: Schematic diagram of the proposed ARMOR framework. This framework consists of an MLLM and a pre-trained VQVAE decoder; The codebook of MLLM is expanded to accommodate image information. Generation is completely based on the autoregressive architecture, and special tokens are used as switches for modality switching.
